en_title: Nintendo Was Reportedly Unhappy With Elon Musk's Saturday Night Live Wario Sketch
cn_title: 据称任天堂不满马斯克瓦力欧短剧
subtitle: 笑话让任天堂不适
opus_summary: 任天堂两名前公关经理透露，公司不喜欢马斯克2021年在《周六夜现场》中饰演瓦力欧的短剧。剧中涉及毒品和性的笑话让任天堂不适，当时也没有瓦力欧新游戏或产品。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo was reportedly unhappy with Elon Musk's 2021 Saturday Night Live sketch where he played Wario.
paragraphs.cn: 据称，任天堂对埃隆·马斯克2021年在《周六夜现场》中饰演瓦力欧的短剧感到不满。

paragraphs.en: In 2021, Elon Musk starred in a Saturday Night Live sketch where he played Wario. The nefarious Nintendo character took the stand in a courtroom, where he was being accused of murdering everyone's favorite plumber, Mario. The skit was poorly received online and, apparently, by Nintendo itself. Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang, two former Nintendo PR managers, revealed in a recent episode of their YouTube show that the SNL skit "did not go well" with Nintendo at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 2021年，埃隆·马斯克主演了《周六夜现场》的一出短剧，饰演瓦力欧。这个任天堂旗下的邪恶角色站上法庭证人席，被指控谋杀了大家最喜爱的水管工马力欧。这出短剧在网上反响不佳，任天堂自己似乎也不喜欢。任天堂两名前公关经理Kit Ellis和Krysta Yang在最近一期YouTube节目中透露，这出《周六夜现场》短剧当时在任天堂那里「反响不好」。

paragraphs.en: The two got on the subject following the recent Saturday Night Live sketch where The Legend of Zelda protagonist Link and GTA 6's Jason Duvall debated each other over who would have the better game. The sketch largely pokes fun at The Legend of Zelda while trying to make GTA 6 seem like the "cooler" game, which itself led to some mixed reactions online. Nevertheless, Ellis and Yang think that it probably went over better than Musk's sketch.
paragraphs.cn: 两人聊起这个话题，是因为《周六夜现场》最近播出了一出短剧，让《塞尔达传说》主角林克和《GTA6》的Jason Duvall争论谁的游戏会更好。这出短剧主要拿《塞尔达传说》开玩笑，同时试图把《GTA6》塑造成「更酷」的游戏，也在网上引发了褒贬不一的反应。不过，Ellis和Yang认为，这出短剧的反响可能还是比马斯克那出更好。

paragraphs.en: The two recalled being at Nintendo when the skit aired and stated that it was "not beloved." Ellis went on to note that the sketch was also oddly timed, as there wasn't even a new Wario game or product when it happened. He went on to say that the sketch also pushed into "uncomfortable" for Nintendo, likely referencing some of the more risque jokes in the skit. The SNL crew made jokes about Mario using cocaine, Luigi sleeping with Princess Peach, and featured a video of Luigi's censored penis. It was... interesting, to say the least.
paragraphs.cn: 两人回忆说，短剧播出时他们还在任天堂工作，并表示这出短剧「不受欢迎」。Ellis还指出，短剧播出的时机也很奇怪，因为当时甚至没有瓦力欧的新游戏或新产品。他接着说，这出短剧还到了让任天堂感到「不适」的地步，可能是在指剧中一些更露骨的笑话。《周六夜现场》团队拿马力欧吸食可卡因、路易吉与碧姬公主上床开玩笑，还放了一段路易吉阴茎被打码的视频。至少可以说，这出短剧……挺有意思。

paragraphs.en: Naturally, it's understandable if Nintendo wasn't thrilled about its family-friendly characters being portrayed as sexual deviants. SNL has parodied Nintendo a number of other times, including a sketch featuring a dark and gritty version of Mario Kart , heavily inspired by HBO's adaptation of The Last of Us.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，如果任天堂不喜欢自家老少皆宜的角色被塑造成性行为越轨的人，也可以理解。《周六夜现场》还曾多次恶搞任天堂，其中一出短剧把《马力欧卡丁车》改成了黑暗、冷峻的版本，很大程度上借鉴了HBO改编剧《最后生还者》。
